messages.subject: ShinyAPP successfully uploaded and opens from sleeping state but is not reactive
parts:
I have a shinyapp that works well locally on rstudio.  It is large, has about 63 MB of data tables of words and frequencies.

I have successfully uploaded to shinyapp.io.  When I enter the link into the browser when the program is in sleeping state, the application does come up after 10-13 seconds but does not react to text input.  If I close the browser (now the app is in running state) the open the browser back up and enter the link it works like a champ.  I have also tried entering text input when initiating from a sleeping state and waiting 20 minutes but still does not react.

I need mentoring or guidance on how on where to look to fix this.  There is no error in the shinyapp logs.
